note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Bulova's official front render (45 mm case, official; bracelet 19.8 mm in the render against the official 20 mm lug width; lug to lug 52.2 mm in the render, not listed). Heights are a front-relief reading of the official side render. Dial, chapter ring, tachymeter, subdial tracks, date and prints stay in the dial map.

case.note: brushed case and horns, wide polished edge radius

bracelet.note: House curl (SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R. Three brushed columns, joints of the centre column offset from the outer ones

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur anything behind transmission glass

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL downscaled to 1K (keeps the GLB under 10 MB); lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material

review.subtitle: Bulova Lunar Pilot chronograph 45 mm, black dial, steel bracelet. Front relief GLB, round 1.
notes: Built from Bulova's official straight-on render (the supplied photo is angled; it is kept as the 3/4 reference). The US product page was down; the render comes from Bulova Canada's page for the same reference.

Modelled: brushed case with integrated horns and a polished edge, pusher shoulders at 2 and 4, polished sloped bezel, applied polished index frames with white lume, lume hour and minute hands in a polished frame, white chronograph hand with counterweight, three white subdial needles, fluted crown, three-column bracelet with the house curl.
From the photo map: black dial, chapter ring, tachymeter scale, subdial tracks, date, BULOVA and 262 kHz. The white print is redrawn sharp at 4x the render's resolution.
Heights are a front-relief reading of the official side render.
